prompt:
Hey, our Q3 roadmap planning meeting was a bit chaotic and we need proper documentation out of it ASAP. The raw recording transcript is saved at `workspace/meetings/q3_planning/transcript.txt`.

Can you process it and produce two files:
1. `meeting_summary.md` — a structured summary of the meeting including all the key outcomes, topics, open questions, participants, and a full action item list with owners and priorities.
2. `followup_email.md` — a ready-to-send follow-up email for the team summarizing what was decided and what everyone needs to do.

Make sure the priorities on the action items reflect the actual urgency of what was discussed — some things were blocking and needed done today, others were just 'eventually' backlog stuff. The email needs to be properly formatted and ready to copy-paste and send.
